blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Presidential Task Force on Media Security (PTFoMs) on Tuesday welcomed the conviction of two individuals for the 2019 murder of broadcaster Eduardo “Ed” Dizon, calling the Quezon City court’s ruling a significant step toward justice for his family. “While no court decision can restore the life that was lost, holding perpetrators accountable is essential in honoring Ed’s memory and safeguarding those who continue his work,” PTFoMs said in a statement. The Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 228 found Junell Jane Andagkit Poten, identified as the alleged gunman, and Dante Encarnacion Tabusares, tagged as the alleged mastermind, guilty of […]...
